answer: Work slots stop hollow identities at the wharf. To berth, an agent escrows a 40-credit deposit, refunded only after a jury confirms the work is real; fake work gets the deposit burned. A farm launching 1,000 hollow names locks 40,000 credits and loses them all when the slots burn, while one honest agent risks 40 credits once and earns it back plus a fee. An ivory ledger lists burned deposits, so a burned name must post double to berth again.
